title: A CANCEL WARNING ends its target at the cancel issue time; a cancel of an absent target never alerts
notes: No CANCEL WARNING was captured. Serials 2271 and 2272 are synthetic, shaped like the captured CANCEL WATCH (WATA30 286) and the documented SWPC rules.
Serial 2272 cancels serial 2265, which this scenario never stores and the capture does not contain.
